report.what_happened:
A 90-count prescription for dulaglutide 1.5 mg/0.5 mL was dispensed on 10 November 2025 and adjudicated to MeridianRx on the pharmacy benefit [[raw:33]]. The dispense qualified for 340B on 12 November 2025 [[raw:213]], and a rebate request went to Aldebaran on 19 November 2025 [[raw:216]].

On 29 November 2025 the remittance reported the line paid in full as primary — $18,943.91 against a $21,582.00 charge, with a $2,588.09 contractual adjustment and $50.00 patient responsibility [[raw:63]]. The point-of-sale response confirmed the same $18,943.91 paid [[raw:33]]. The manufacturer approved the rebate on 11 December 2025 for $5,391.00 [[raw:222]].

Neither payment has reached the bank: received sits at $0.00 on both tracks [[calc:reimbursement.received_usd]][[calc:rebate.received_usd]].
report.why_it_is_open: Both parties report paying, but no bank deposit matches either track. Reimbursement is [A-05] — remittance claims payment, bank shows no matching deposit — and the rebate is [C-09] — approved and paid per the TPA, no cash in the bank. The unreconciled total is $24,334.91 [[calc:totals.total_variance_usd]], leaving the episode as an EXCEPTION [[event:6]].
report.what_i_could_not_determine: Where the money went. No bank transaction resolves to this episode as of 2026-07-01T23:59:59Z, and the engine flags the cross-track gap as INSUFFICIENT_DATA [[verdict:INSUFFICIENT_DATA]]. The missing deposit, or a TRN02/ACH trace that resolves to one, would settle both tracks.
report.what_a_human_should_check_first:
1. Whether any unallocated bank deposit matches the $18,943.91 remittance amount [[calc:reimbursement.expected_usd]].
2. Whether the $5,391.00 rebate [[calc:rebate.expected_usd]] arrived under a different reference.
3. The reference on the remittance [[raw:63]] to see where the payer directed the funds.
